mapper.select: SELECT FROM tbl_material_out_sheet WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT mos.id, mos.code, mos.sc_id AS scId, sc.name AS scName, mos.supplier_id AS supplierId, s.name AS supplierName, mos.material_user_id AS materialUserId, u.name AS materialUserName, mos.material_date AS materialDate, mos.material_order_id AS materialOrderId, mo.code AS materialOrderCode, mos.total_num AS totalNum, mos.total_amount AS totalAmount, mos.status, mos.description, mos.create_by AS createBy, mos.create_time AS createTime, mos.update_by AS updateBy, mos.update_time AS updateTime, mos.approve_by AS approveBy, mos.approve_time AS approveTime, mos.refuse_reason AS refuseReason FROM tbl_material_out_sheet mos LEFT JOIN base_data_store_center sc ON mos.sc_id = sc.id LEFT JOIN base_data_supplier s ON mos.supplier_id = s.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON mos.material_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN shkb_material_order mo ON mos.material_order_id = mo.id WHERE mos.id = #{id}

SELECT d.id AS id, d.sheet_id AS sheetId, d.product_id AS productId, p.code AS productCode, p.name AS productName, pc.name AS categoryName, pb.name AS brandName, p.sku_code AS skuCode, p.external_code AS externalCode, p.unit AS unit, p.spec AS spec, p.is_batch AS isBatch, p.is_serial AS isSerial, d.out_num AS outNum, d.order_num AS orderNum, skmod.out_num AS orderOutNum, d.tax_price AS taxPrice, d.tax_amount AS taxAmount, d.description AS description, d.order_no AS orderNo, d.material_order_detail_id AS materialOrderDetailId, ps.stock_num AS stockNum FROM tbl_material_out_sheet_detail d LEFT JOIN tbl_material_out_sheet mos ON mos.id = d.sheet_id LEFT JOIN base_data_product p ON p.id = d.product_id LEFT JOIN base_data_product_category pc ON pc.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN base_data_product_brand pb ON pb.id = p.brand_id LEFT JOIN tbl_product_stock ps ON mos.sc_id = ps.sc_id and d.product_id = ps.product_id LEFT JOIN shkb_material_order_detail skmod ON d.material_order_detail_id = skmod.id WHERE d.sheet_id = #{id} ORDER BY d.order_no ASC

SELECT NULL AS id, d.id AS detailId, d.stock_batch_id AS lotId, psb.batch_number AS lotCode, d.out_num AS outNum, 1 AS orderNo FROM tbl_material_out_sheet_detail d LEFT JOIN tbl_product_stock_batch psb ON psb.id = d.stock_batch_id WHERE d.id = #{id}

SELECT pss.id AS id, d.id AS detailId, pss.serial_number AS serialNumber, 0 AS orderNo FROM tbl_material_out_sheet_detail d INNER JOIN tbl_material_out_sheet_detail_serial s ON s.sheet_id = d.sheet_id AND s.product_id = d.product_id LEFT JOIN tbl_product_stock_serial pss ON pss.id = s.stock_serial_id WHERE d.id = #{id} ORDER BY pss.create_time ASC

SELECT psb.id AS id, psb.sc_id AS scId, sc.name AS scName, psb.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, p.code AS partNumberCode, mt.name AS machineType, psb.batch_number AS batchNumber, psb.quantity AS quantity, psb.production_date AS productionDate, psb.expiry_date AS expiryDate FROM tbl_product_stock_batch psb LEFT JOIN base_data_store_center sc ON sc.id = psb.sc_id LEFT JOIN base_data_product p ON p.id = psb.product_id LEFT JOIN base_data_machine_type mt ON p.machine_type_id = mt.id
psb.sc_id = #{scId} AND psb.product_id = #{productId} AND psb.quantity > 0
ORDER BY psb.create_time ASC

SELECT pss.id AS id, pss.serial_number AS serialNumber, psb.batch_number AS batchNumber, psb.sc_id AS scId, sc.name AS scName, pss.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, p.code AS partNumberCode, mt.name AS machineType, pss.stock_status AS stockStatus, pss.production_date AS productionDate, pss.expiry_date AS expiryDate FROM tbl_product_stock_serial pss LEFT JOIN tbl_product_stock_batch psb ON psb.id = pss.batch_id LEFT JOIN base_data_store_center sc ON sc.id = psb.sc_id LEFT JOIN base_data_product p ON p.id = pss.product_id LEFT JOIN base_data_machine_type mt ON p.machine_type_id = mt.id
psb.sc_id = #{scId} AND pss.product_id = #{productId} AND pss.stock_status = 1
ORDER BY pss.create_time ASC

SELECT id, task_id AS taskId, apply_code AS applyCode, create_time AS createTime, approval_status AS approvalStatus, remark, approval_time AS approvalTime FROM shkb_contract_task_material_apply WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, contract_id AS contractId, task_status AS taskStatus, repair_status AS repairStatus, material_status AS materialStatus, create_by AS createBy, create_by_id AS createById, create_time AS createTime, update_by AS updateBy, update_by_id AS updateById, update_time AS updateTime, dispatch, task_user_id AS taskUserId, description, repair_description AS repairDescription, task_type AS taskType, sh_contract_id AS shContractId, approval_file_number AS approvalFileNumber FROM shkb_contract_task WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, task_id AS taskId, apply_code AS applyCode, create_time AS createTime, approval_status AS approvalStatus, remark, approval_time AS approvalTime FROM shkb_contract_task_material_apply WHERE task_id = #{taskId}

SELECT id, material_apply_id AS materialApplyId, code, total_num AS totalNum, total_out_num AS totalOutNum, is_out_finish AS isOutFinish, create_time AS createTime FROM shkb_material_order WHERE material_apply_id = #{materialApplyId}
